correctness.rationale: The normal form and multiplication follow from moving j past i (central z factor) and reducing i² and j² to z. The even-augmentation ideal has successive power dimensions 7,5,3,1,0; nilpotence and the quotient F₂ identify it with the Jacobson radical. For each ordered (b,c), the witness count is the size of ker ρ_bc minus the intersection with ker ρ_cb, namely 2^(8−r)−2^(8−s). I independently built Q₈ as the eight signed 2-by-2 complex quaternion matrices, used their multiplication to construct the binary ring, computed ideal powers by explicit spans and ranks as log₂ of image cardinalities, and tested the second product directly on the zero set of the first for every ordered pair. This matched all eight rank frequencies, yielding 98,304 and 49,152 witnesses from the only two contributing rank pairs. It found exactly 49,152 at each stated valuation vector and verified the displayed witness has products zero and the nonzero all-group sum. The total is 147,456 and division by 256³ gives 9/1024. The rank table certifies the total via rank-nullity, not by itself the layer counts; the separate valuation census supplies those. Replay: python3 /workspace/audit_replay/quaternion.py; output at /workspace/audit_replay/quaternion.txt.
residual_risks: The count is ordered, over F₂, and for the specific implication abc=0 ⇒ acb=0.
The certificate establishes this finite ring's counts, not a field- or ring-family theorem.

originality.rationale: The strongest same-ring literature supplies existence of witnesses, radical generators and the ring's place in a prior finite classification, not the reported witness counts or joint rank census in the decisive inspected sections. The nearest distinct Resultary comparison supplies a single-element multiplication-rank spectrum for the quaternion block, not the correlation of the products bc and cb or the simultaneous-kernel dimensions. The Pass is restricted to the quantitative joint and layer-refined facts; neither nonsymmetry, minimality nor having an explicit witness is novel.

value.rationale: This algebra is a canonical smallest reversible nonsymmetric ring. Counting the actual failures of symmetry and locating every one in three equally occupied radical-layer configurations characterizes the defect much more precisely than finding a witness. The joint ranks measure a natural correlation of zero-product conditions and give a reusable exact benchmark for comparing this algebra with other minimal nonsymmetric rings. The restriction to one standard algebra is motivated by its role in the classification, not an arbitrary small slice.
residual_risks: Comparative classification of the other minimal rings has not been carried out; benchmark use is prospective.
